blind.description: An open shallow rectangular wooden box or tray with brass corner brackets and front latch hardware. Inside, resting on a beige padded fabric lining, are four golden ritual or embalming tools (a pointed knife, a comb-like or spatulate tool, a spoon-like curette, and a curved hook or blade). Surfaces are solid, smooth, and well-modeled with no floating or broken parts. The underside sits flat on the floor.
blind.from_above: A rectangular brown box oriented horizontally with a cream interior containing four golden tools arranged in a neat parallel row, each having a segmented handle at the top and specialized tool heads at the bottom.
blind.height_vs_figure: Extremely low compared to the 5 ft 9 in figure, standing only about 3 to 4 inches tall, with a width of approximately 1.5 feet and depth of 1 foot.
